description: The source describes requirements to design, construct and operate hydrovac facilities. It says these facilities may accept, treat and reuse hydrovac liquids or solids meeting defined quality standards. This provides process-specific regulatory information for waste treatment. The short metadata description does not state numerical quality thresholds, facility capacities, treatment technologies or monitoring intervals. It links the code through the provincial publisher. That body was not read, and neither current amendments nor the named reuse terms are independently verified. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Alberta King's Printer Terms of Use. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
